newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: S.Korea Daewoo unit in Philippines marina venture.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Daewoo unit in Philippines marina venture.

text.p: Keang Nam Enterprises Ltd, a subsidiary of Daewoo Group, has signed a joint venture agreement to build a marina and waterfront condominiums in the northern Philippines, the group's local partner said on Monday.
The president of local partner Puerto Azul Land Inc (PALI), Jocel Panlilio, said the joint venture company, Grand Kaeng Nam Inc, will build a three-hectare marina.
The marina will include 75 wet berths and a dry berth which can accommodate up to 150 boats, a yacht club, a ferry terminal, and four mid-rise residential condominiums.

The first phase of the project, which is estimated to cost $100 million, is expected to be completed within one-and-a-half years. The second phase, which will take another two years to complete, is expected to cost $150 million, Panlilio added.
"The bulk of the investment will come from Daewoo," Panlilio said, but declined to give the exact amount.
